source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Applying mainly to clients above a certain age threshold, rather than to stroke clients of any age being considered for tPA therapy","B":"Slowing down time-critical treatment in a way that offers fairly little corresponding safety benefit to the client overall","C":"Carrying fairly little established clinical value despite being a standard, required part of tPA administration protocols today","D":"Systematically screen for factors that would make tPA administration unsafe, such as recent surgery or active bleeding, given the significant bleeding risk"}}
source_row.rationale: A standardized tPA contraindication checklist helps systematically screen for factors that would make administration unsafe, such as recent major surgery or active bleeding, given the significant bleeding risk associated with this thrombolytic therapy.
